label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: User input from request parameter flows through doSomething() via Base64 round-trip to bar, then through input variable to the encodeForHTML() sink expression at L84-L90. Although encodeForHTML() is applied, the user-controlled data reaches the HTML output sink on the executed path, making this a genuine XSS vulnerability demonstration.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter() flows through doSomething() and reaches the HTML output sink
